summary: Phase 4 (three quote options, usual price cap, AI ladder, Inbox + request page). Backend: regression test_drivepast_api.py + test_phase2_engine.py + test_phase3_maps.py = 46/46 PASS sequential (-n 0). New /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_options.py (23 tests) = 23/23 PASS covering JRN-53/54/55/56/57, AI config secret-mask + 20s fail timeout, level-1 stub (connect, delay-25 fallback, fail=1 fallback), No-AI mode, Inbox read-all statuses, decline + rail count, incoming-text, OpenAPI exposes new endpoints while /api/dev/stub-llm is hidden, run-all shape has options.cards and <500ms. Frontend (Chromium 1920x1080): /inbox > Read all requests completes in ~8s; status chips 1,2,3,5,10='Priced', 4,6,7,8,9='Needs info'; rail-inbox-count=10, drops to 9 after request-decline-button on req-03 (status chip=Declined). req-01: no needs-clarification; three option cards show Cheapest Van 2 1:45pm $11 / Soonest Van 2 1:45pm $14 / Preferred window Van 2 1:54pm $11 $231/mo, customer line 'Van 2 already passes 0.1 miles from you at 1:50pm, so it's $11 a visit instead of our usual $14.' matches review verbatim; request-see-other-options reveals additional request-other-i cards. req-04: amber problem 'Lakeshore Dental closes at 4:30pm.' + Preferred window Van 2 4:20pm, Cheapest Van 4 4:15pm $35 for the run. req-08: problem 'Berkeley to Mission Bay takes about 35 min, so 8:15am can't work.' and single merged card (Cheapest/Soonest/Preferred window) Van 2 pickup 8:09am drop-off 9:10am $55 capped; explanation 'capped at your usual $55 for the run'; customer line 'Our usual price for this run is $55.' req-06 Ask the vans: 'Can't price yet: we need the delivery addresses.' req-09: 'Looks like a copy of request 1 from 5 minutes earlier.' Settings: usual_recurring=14 / usual_one_off=55 shown; saving floor_recurring=16 renders settings-floor_recurring-error 'Your floor can't be above your usual price of $14 a visit.' and backend PUT /api/settings returns 422 with fields.floor_recurring. Settings > Our model: save secret 'test-secret-1234' displays 'Saved secret ••••1234'; GET /api/ai/config and /api/settings never return the full secret; grep of /var/log/supervisor/backend*.log for the secret = 0 hits (Q-33=0). Level-1 stub: POST /api/ai/test with base <BE>/api/dev/stub-llm model stub-qwen returns ok=true 'Connected · answered in 0.0 s · stub-qwen'; subsequent /api/inbox/req-01/read returns ai.level=1, ai.tag='our model', ai.model='stub-qwen'. ?delay=25 and ?fail=1 both fall back to backup (level 2). No-AI mode (PUT /api/ai/config {mode:'none'}): read-all succeeds, req-01 details contain 'Temescal'/'5200 Shattuck'/'Ashby', ai.level in (2,3). /api/openapi.json contains /api/inbox, /api/inbox/read-all, /api/inbox/incoming-text, /api/inbox/{key}/ask-vans/ask-customer/decline, /api/ai/config, /api/ai/test; stub-llm is NOT in paths. POST /api/inbox/incoming-text creates source='text' request. Engine run-all returns 10 results each with options.cards and ms<500 (observed ~28ms per price). Perf: /api/engine/price req-01 ms=28.8 (well under 500 ms budget / REQ-199). Q-32 price band verified on req-01 ($11-$14) and req-08 ($35-$55) and with usual_one_off=40 scenario (loses_money=true, hold_as_draft=true, price=40 for any added_cost>40, nothing above 40 or below floor_one_off=35). Demo state reset at start and end; AI config cleared at end.

integration_issues.flow: Request 6 Ask the customer -> request-question-input value
integration_issues.issue: After clicking request-ask-customer-button, textarea value was empty when queried at ~3s. The /api/inbox/{key}/ask-customer call may be slower than 3s on backup level, or the response shape returned question outside the expected key. Not fully reproducible — needs a longer wait window. The question textarea DOES render for other requests after reload. Low priority.

integration_issues.flow: Add a request (paste text) -> dialog closes within 25s (Q-29)
integration_issues.issue: Paste-and-submit flow for Rockridge Florist text was still showing 'Reading the request...' at the 20s mark in one headless run (dialog not yet closed). Backend API POST /api/inbox succeeds and the new request is created, but the modal/UX exceeds the 8s plan target. Not a bug per Must=25s; verify under full backup latency.

action_items: (Optional) Confirm request-ask-customer draft returns within 3-5s on backup level, or add a lightweight optimistic placeholder in RequestPage so request-question-input/question-tag appear immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: engine/options.py tiebreak uses pick_t: for req-01, Van 2 'Cheapest' lands on the 1:45pm insertion with added_cost=2.65 while 'Preferred window' lands on the 1:54pm insertion with the same added_cost=2.65. Both are legitimate; a tiebreaker preferring the slot with the lower added_minutes (both =8) and then pass_by distance would collapse them into a single shared card as JRN-53 hints ('shared candidate shows once with both labels'). Currently they render as two cards with identical price/cost but different arrival_label. Confirm with product if this is intended.

engine/options.py build_options sets _raw which is leaked in the response under some paths; HIDDEN already strips 'nodes','base_keys','_extras' but not '_raw' from the top-level options dict (not the card). Verify /api/engine/price serialization does not accidentally include large _raw blobs.
ai/ladder.py secret handling confirmed: full secret never present in API responses or logs. Keep this invariant covered by test_phase4_options::TestAIConfig::test_save_secret_masked_everywhere.
pytest.ini still defaults to '-n 2 --dist loadscope'; new test_phase4_options.py relies on shared /api/demo state so always run with '-n 0' (already specified in review and in ci command above).

frontend OptionCards markup: each card groups many child DOM nodes with the same '[data-testid^=request-option-]' prefix; precise card-count queries should prefer '[data-testid^=request-option-]:not([data-testid*="-"]) ' or expose a dedicated 'request-option-i-root' testid.
test_credentials: No login. Stub model via <BE>/api/dev/stub-llm, model 'stub-qwen', any secret.
seed_data_creation: None. Used built-in seed. Demo + AI config reset at start and end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend as: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/phase4.xml` (xdist breaks because tests mutate shared demo state). Key response shapes: GET /api/settings -> {settings:{...}}, not flat. Inbox detail /api/inbox/{key} -> ai.{level,tag,model,seconds,at} (tag='our model'|'backup'|'no ai (keyword reader)'); legacy top-level ai_tag is not populated. /api/engine/price returns options={cards:[], others:[], from_shifted}. /api/engine/run-all is POST (405 on GET). Stub LLM at /api/dev/stub-llm supports ?delay=NN and ?fail=1 query params. Options cards for req-01 are three separate cards (Van 2 1:45pm Cheapest $11, Van 2 1:45pm Soonest $14, Van 2 1:54pm Preferred window $11) — review's 'shared candidate shows once with both labels' only merges when the SAME engine candidate is picked by multiple labels, as in req-08 where one shifted result wins all three labels.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking functional issues. Minor UX observations captured above.
